compatible_replacement_and_complete_join: Retain all eight actual product holes, including the four unused ones, in every geometry/net-section/heel/contact calculation.

Any alternative part must bind exact dimensional datums, arm/breadth/thickness minima and maxima, both four-hole patterns, included angle and formed heel; a larger gross envelope is not a minimum-strength guarantee.
Use the installed far pair per flange and3/8-inch through bolts only after the actual factory hole/bolt tolerance stack and all receiver edge/end/grain/cut distances are joined to the new geometry.

Washer ID must clear the delivered shank/thread envelope; OD and thickness must retain full receiving-seat support, hole-wall clearance, neighboring unused-hole and heel clearance, and installation access on each own head/nut side.

Each bolt length/shank/thread scenario must cover its new actual grip, every shear/bearing plane, both washers and full metal-nut engagement. Nominal purchased length is not delivered unthreaded shank.
Bind actual bolt/head/nut/washer geometry and material/strength sources. Circular collision envelopes and solid-nut envelopes cannot be used as mechanical pressure footprints.
New blocks/cleats, all changed axes and original frame-bolt arrangements need their own geometry/mechanics/source state. No old count, fit, force, shop pass or capacity transfers.

A compatible geometry is not equivalent joint stiffness or resistance. Heel/holes, prying/warping, bolt bending/bearing/shear/tension, timber splitting/bearing/net section, contact and whole-joint load paths remain unresolved.
No preload, tightening torque, friction or annular pressure couple is supplied by this product-source record.
